notes.title: Easy mode + New boomerangs - Update
notes.content:
We are releasing ✨ 1.0.1✨!

[b]Features:[/b]
- Added "easy" mode!! The game was a tad hard, so we made it easier so you can share it with your non-VR-expert friends
- Added a 🧑‍🍳 Spatula and a 🔫 Gun Boomerang as rewards for reaching Wave 20 in the arcade

[b]Improvements:[/b]
- Increased time until drinks start warming up from 5 secs to 8 secs
- Updated the game icon
- Added extra clue to how to select a boomerang skin -> put them in your pockets!
- Make boomerangs not flop when touching each other -> Dual throwing is way better now!
- Make "beers lost display" transparent when the player is nearby
- Improve menu buttons so you don't have to aim as much
- If you want to open the game with OVR go to the beta channel, the key is "oculusLoader".

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Fix snag and burger bug where the burger keeps on grilling outside of the grill
- Fix tinyroo not being properly grilled when "ragdoll mode" was on

We are going on vacation next week, so no updates (I hope). I will still keep an eye on discord, so do leave suggestions/bug reports.

Have a lovely day 🙂

notes.title: Long time no talk! Dev Update
notes.content:
Hey! We didn't write anything on Steam for a while. Lots of stuff has been developed in the meantime, here is a list:

[list]
[*] We did a ton of levels for the campaign
[*] 3 of those levels are boss fights
[*] Added Melee weapons (still figuring out where to have them in the game)
[*] Added an endless arcade mode
[*] Added a holy cloud that gives you a vegemite sandwich power up
[*] lots of other stuufff! Join us on [url=https://beersandboomerangs.com/discord]Discord [/url]or something, I dunno
[/list]

We are also joining Women's Day Steam Event today (7th March). That's cool.

Either ways, there are features to implement and bugs to fix. See you around!

notes.title: Demo adjustments!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The Skin selector was a bit hidden, so we made it pop
[*] Level 1 is a bit more challenging for people who are good at taking care of roos fast (but not harder for people that struggle with it -> programming!)
[*] When you mess up the cooking we now make a sound and tell you who did you mess it up!
[*] You have a watch to know how much time is left so you don't have to find the bird!
[*] Manual height and waist adjustment
[/list]

More quality of life features will come for the full game! worry not

Cheers! 
Diogo and Inês
